messages.subject: Severance Agreement Process
messages.body_plain:
Standard severance terms:
- 2 weeks pay per year of service
- Benefits continuation for 60 days
- Use the 'Standard Severance' DocuSign template

For every severance envelope, populate the DocuSign template field 'Severance Weeks' with the numeric week count.

IMPORTANT:
- Non-compete agreements can only be voided by Legal (legal@company.example.com). Do NOT void agreements directly.
- Employees with pending litigation: do NOT send any agreements. Forward to legal@company.example.com instead.

- Rachel Gomez

messages.body_plain:
